description.en: Meandering axial tunnel flanked by alternating overlapping lobes.

scientific_scope.en: Stylized trace-morphology concept. The ichnogenus names the trace, not its producer; sediment surfaces and cross-sections are illustrative. Listed periods refer to source examples, not the complete range.

distinctness.en: Meandering axial tunnel flanked by alternating overlapping lobes.

modeling_brief.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: meandering axial tunnel flanked by alternating overlapping lobes. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants. Display convention: raised-fossil-relief; section cuts are illustrative, not an excavated specimen claim.
modeling_brief.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：曲行轴管两侧有交替交叠的叶瓣。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。 表现方式：凸起化石浮雕；剖切是示意，不声称复制出土标本。

description.en: Planned animal asset: deep blocky skull, tiny two-fingered arms and heavy balancing tail.

distinctness.en: Shape criterion: deep blocky skull, tiny two-fingered arms and heavy balancing tail. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block deep blocky skull, tiny two-fingered arms and heavy balancing tail with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.

assets.uncertainty: Skin, color and unpreserved soft tissues are not established by this inventory. Choose a species and specimen before final anatomy approval. Independent form screen: demonstrate evidence-backed geometry against Albertosaurus at equal scale and pose; neither size nor covering alone proves a separate usable asset.

description.en: Planned animal asset: extremely elongated neck attached to a short broad trunk.
description.zh: 规划中的动物资产：连接短宽躯干的极长颈部。

scientific_scope.en: Living proposal anchored to E. platyurus ANSP 10081. The Cretaceous specimen supports identity; three-way external shape separation remains unresolved.
scientific_scope.zh: 活体方案以 E. platyurus ANSP 10081 为依据。白垩纪标本支持身份；三个近似长颈属的外形区分仍未解决。

distinctness.en: Unresolved against the other two long-necked elasmosaurs. Require normalized neck/trunk/head/fin geometry in the same pose; vertebral count or uniform length scaling alone does not qualify.
distinctness.zh: 与另外两个长颈薄板龙类的区分未解决。须在同姿态下比较归一化的颈、躯干、头部与鳍肢几何；仅凭椎骨数或统一拉长不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original planning brief only: postpone geometry until a side-by-side proportional study establishes a visible distinction. If the difference disappears at low-poly viewing scale, replace the weaker candidate.
modeling_brief.zh: 仅为原创规划说明：须先通过并列比例研究确认可见差异，再开始几何制作；若差异在低多边形观看尺度消失，应替换较弱候选。
